factProposals.value: The plan defines no requirements, agents, measures, roles, guardrails or systems yet, so six Command Center tabs show empty states.

decisions.statement: The Command Center is a static page with no API and no model; it reads the .colaberry files at runtime.
decisions.rationale: a public static page cannot keep a secret

decisions.statement: The knowledge base chat answers by matching the question against the loaded files and says when it cannot answer.
decisions.rationale: no model or key on a public page; answers must cite the tab they came from

decisions.statement: Email addresses are hidden on every screen.
decisions.rationale: the plan text contains a personal email and the page may be published

limitations.statement: Connection and run status cannot be seen from the repository files, so every status light stays grey and reads not checked from here.
Every release in the plan starts and ends on 2026-10-01, so the Gantt bars have no length.
